description: This file is a test configuration script for a Python project using pytest. It defines fixtures for setting up a test database, a FastAPI application, and a synchronous HTTP client wrapper around an async client, specifically tailored for testing an API backend.

classes.name: SyncHttpxClient
classes.description: A synchronous wrapper around the httpx.AsyncClient to allow sync test code to make HTTP requests using asyncio under the hood.

methods.name: SyncHttpxClient.request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request of a specified method using the underlying async client, run synchronously via anyio.run.

methods.name: SyncHttpxClient.get
methods.description: Convenience method for performing a GET request.

methods.name: SyncHttpxClient.post
methods.description: Convenience method for performing a POST request.

methods.name: SyncHttpxClient.patch
methods.description: Convenience method for performing a PATCH request.

methods.name: SyncHttpxClient.delete
methods.description: Convenience method for performing a DELETE request.

methods.name: SyncHttpxClient.close
methods.description: Closes the async client by running its aclose coroutine.

methods.name: str sqlite_db_path(tmp_path: Path)
methods.description: Fixture that provides a temporary file path for an SQLite database for each test.

methods.name: app(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, sqlite_db_path: str)
methods.description: Fixture that sets environment variables, reloads the main application module, and returns a FastAPI app instance connected to a temporary SQLite database.

methods.name: Generator[SyncHttpxClient,None,None] client(app)
methods.description: Fixture that provides a synchronized HTTP client to interact with the FastAPI app via ASGITransport within tests.
